instruction: Pick up the mallet and strike all xylophone keys from left to right.

frames.label: turn 1: Tap each of the 8 xylophone bars once, along the row from left to right - red, orange, yellow, green, light blue, dark blue, purple, pink - i.e. longest bar first, shortest last; a bar counts only after every bar to its left has been tapped. One tap = the round mallet head (not the fingertips) over the middle of that bar, a dip to a finger's width above it, then a lift clear of the bars; one dip per bar. The row lies at a slight angle, so each next bar is a little nearer the robot as well as further right - aim at the bar in the picture, not a fixed sideways step. Tapped so far: none yet (0 of 8); next is the red bar. Neither arm reaches the whole row: the left hand taps its own side, then lays the mallet flat on the bare table in front of the robot for the right hand to take by its free end.
